assignments.name: Pause-and-try problems
assignments.description: Every lesson stops at least once for a problem set in the running case, such as a new break-even point for the coffee shop or the standard error for a smaller hospital sample. Students pause, work it on paper, then watch the solution worked out by hand.

assignments.name: Module 4 hands-on practice
assignments.description: A full lesson of five exercises on one week of Steel City Streaming data: center, spread, a histogram, a box plot, and a correlation, ending with a one-paragraph analyst's report for an executive.

assignments.name: Diagnostic pretest, module quizzes, and posttest
assignments.description: The workshop is designed to open with a diagnostic pretest that shows each student which topics need the most work, give a short low-stakes quiz with immediate feedback at the end of each module, and close with a comprehensive posttest.
